notes.title: Hollow Floor - Release Date
notes.notes:
I hope that you are all alright. About the release date, the game is almost done and it is in its final testing phase so finally, a release date is available which is August 27th ːsteamhappyː ːsteamhappyː ːsteamhappyː ːsteamhappyː

If you haven't heard about Hollow Floor, It is a small metroidvania inspired by VVVVVV and REDDER. I have been working on it for multiple years. Now, try the game and leave comments and feedback :) Also if you enjoyed it please wishlist it on Steam. I am looking forward to everyone testing the final game when it comes out.
